rules.rule: a matched instrument comparison is feasible at n available independent files only if n >= min_independent_files, the confirmation calibration is complete and within tolerance at the largest calibrated n_files <= n, the maximum withholding rate over the non-drift scenarios is <= max_withholding_rate, the medium-effect power is >= min_power_medium_effect, and the development dependence verdict is not inconclusive; otherwise the output is a feasibility failure with its reasons, never an artificial four-file significance claim
